signals.title: Codex rejects obsolete permission-profile fields instead of silently ignoring requested policy
signals.title_zh: Codex 拒绝过时权限字段，避免请求的权限策略被静默忽略
signals.summary: App-server request handling now rejects the removed permissionProfile field on thread/start, thread/resume, thread/fork and turn/start instead of allowing deserialization to ignore it, preventing a caller from believing a permission request took effect when it did not.
signals.summary_zh: App Server 现在会在 thread/start、thread/resume、thread/fork 与 turn/start 上拒绝已移除的 permissionProfile 字段，而不是让反序列化静默忽略，从而避免调用方误以为权限请求已经生效。

signals.title: Codex preserves legacy project-root restrictions as workspace-root policy
signals.title_zh: Codex 将旧 project_roots 继续解释为 workspace_roots 权限策略
signals.summary: Codex parses legacy :project_roots entries as an alias for :workspace_roots, preserving deny rules and read-only carve-outs that could otherwise be dropped when older permission profiles are loaded.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 将旧版 :project_roots 解析为 :workspace_roots 的别名，保留拒绝规则与只读子路径例外，避免加载旧权限 Profile 时意外丢失文件系统限制。

signals.title: Codex applies shell-variable policy from the selected execution environment
signals.title_zh: Codex 按所选执行环境应用 Shell 变量策略
signals.summary: Resolved EnvironmentConfig now carries its ShellEnvironmentPolicy, and shell handlers filter inherited variables according to the selected turn environment while preserving that environment's explicit overrides.
signals.summary_zh: 解析后的 EnvironmentConfig 现在携带各自的 ShellEnvironmentPolicy；Shell 处理器按当前 Turn 选择的环境过滤继承变量，同时保留该环境的显式覆盖。

signals.title: Codex restores independent persisted thread timestamp maxima correctly
signals.title_zh: Codex 独立恢复持久化线程时间戳最大值
signals.summary: State initialization now loads updated_at_ms and recency_at_ms maxima with independent scalar subqueries so each counter is restored correctly even when the maxima belong to different threads, with a reopen regression test covering the case.
signals.summary_zh: 状态初始化现在通过独立标量子查询加载 updated_at_ms 与 recency_at_ms 最大值，因此即使两个最大值来自不同线程也能分别正确恢复，并增加了重开状态数据库的回归测试。

signals.title: Codex compacts successful command activity without discarding the full transcript
signals.title_zh: Codex 压缩成功命令活动展示但保留完整执行记录
signals.summary: The TUI groups consecutive successful agent and unified-exec startup commands into compact entries while preserving the full transcript, and flushes groups at failures, interaction boundaries and a bounded group size; replay follows the same rules.
signals.summary_zh: TUI 将连续成功的 Agent 与 unified-exec 启动命令聚合为紧凑条目，同时保留完整 Transcript；失败、交互边界以及达到有界分组大小时会刷新分组，历史重放也使用相同规则。

signals.title: Codex doctor classifies route-aware network failures into actionable diagnostics
signals.title_zh: Codex doctor 将路由感知网络故障分类为可操作诊断
signals.summary: codex doctor now probes the configured Responses inference endpoint through the route-aware client and classifies TLS, proxy authentication, proxy configuration, resolution and timeout failures while accounting for custom CA and provider-specific routing.
signals.summary_zh: codex doctor 现在通过路由感知客户端探测配置的 Responses 推理端点，并对 TLS、代理认证、代理配置、域名解析与超时故障分类，同时考虑自定义 CA 与 Provider 特定路由。
